quarterly_data.signal: Southern Company's 10-K states its traditional electric operating companies are experiencing projected demand that significantly exceeds recent experience, with the majority driven by the power needs and projected power needs of data centers, including to support artificial intelligence, creating the need for new generating resources and transmission facilities. Georgia Power has agreed to file its next base rate case so that incremental revenue from large load customers has downward pressure, on a levelized basis, of at least $556 million per year for 2029, 2030 and 2031.
